verses.text: Brothers and sisters, now we want to talk about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and how we will be gathered together to meet him. We ask you

not to be quickly upset in your minds or alarmed. Some may say that the day of the Lord has already come. They may claim it came from a spirit, or a spoken message, or a letter that seems to be from us.
Do not let anyone trick you in any way. That day will not come until the great turning away from God happens first, and the man of sin is shown for who he is, the one who is doomed to be destroyed.
He will oppose and set himself above everything that is called God or is worshipped. He will even sit in God's temple and claim that he himself is God.
Do you not remember that I told you these things when I was still with you?
And you know what is holding him back now, so that he will be shown only at the right time.
The secret power of lawlessness is already at work. But the one who holds it back will keep doing so until he is taken out of the way.
Then the lawless one will be shown. The Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath of his mouth, and destroy him by the brightness of his coming.
The lawless one will come by Satan's work. He will use all kinds of power and signs and false wonders.
He will use every kind of evil trick on those who are being lost. They are lost because they refused to love the truth that would save them.
Because of this, God sends them a powerful lie to fool them, so that they will believe what is false.
So all who have not believed the truth, but have enjoyed doing wrong, will be judged.
But we must always thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord. From the beginning God chose you to be saved, through the Spirit making you holy and through your belief in the truth.
He called you to this through the Good News we preached, so that you would share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm. Hold on to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by what we said or by our letter.
Our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father loved us. By his grace he gave us comfort that lasts for ever and a good hope.
May they comfort your hearts and make you strong in every good thing you do and say.
